senses.zh_definition: Weyland：外来姓氏或其他专名；具体所指须由上下文确定，不具有已核实的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Weyland, a surname or other proper name whose referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas asing yang boleh digunakan sebagai nama keluarga; rujukan khususnya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词处理；马来文释义为编辑性说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。status 设为 unverified，避免把无 DBP 释义的输入标成官方普通词条。以下搭配及情境均为姓氏用法示例，不代表已核实的高频搭配，也不指向真实人物。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Encik Weyland dah sampai kat lobi. Kau nak turun sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Encik Weyland sudah tiba di lobi. Adakah awak mahu turun sekarang?
messages.zh: Weyland 先生到大厅了。你现在要下去吗？
messages.en: Mr Weyland is in the lobby. Are you coming down now?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku turun sekarang. Tolong sambut dia dulu, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya akan turun sekarang. Tolong sambut beliau dahulu.
messages.zh: 嗯，我现在下去。麻烦你先接待一下他。
messages.en: Yes, I'm coming down now. Could you welcome him first?

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Weyland as a German variant of Wieland and an English variant of Wayland. Those alternatives show why the spelling alone cannot determine a bearer's language or family history. In a Malay text, the name retains its identifying function rather than acquiring a new ordinary Malay meaning. [Surname dictionary](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/weyland)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Weyland 想成名牌上的姓名：首字母大写，整词识别；不要把 land 当成马来语词根来拆。
